name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship
provider: U.S. Department of State / U.S. Embassy Dhaka
who: Bangladeshi mid-career professionals (public, private, NGO, research) with a 4-year bachelor's or a master's, at least 5 years' full-time experience and management/policy responsibility; resident in Bangladesh
benefits: Nine-month non-degree programme in the United States
notes: 2027-28 call closed 13 Aug 2026; embassy page gives April–June as the usual window

name: ITEC training courses 2026-27
provider: Government of India (ITEC) / High Commission of India, Dhaka
who: Bangladeshi professionals; course-specific eligibility; Bangladesh listed as a participating country for courses in the 2026-27 brochure
benefits: Short courses at Indian institutes (benefits per course brochure)
notes: Apply online on the ITEC portal; planner tentative as of 14 Aug 2026; courses run into March 2027

name: JICA Knowledge Co-Creation Program (KCCP)
who: Professionals nominated by their organisation; age and experience limits differ by course (e.g. 25–45, 3+ years in the field)
benefits: Training in Japan (per course General Information)
notes: Deadlines per course — confirm with the JICA Bangladesh office or the Embassy of Japan

name: KOICA Fellowship Program (short courses and master's)
who: Government officials officially nominated by their ministry; in Bangladesh nominations are routed through the Economic Relations Division (ERD); preference under 40; strong English
benefits: Training courses and (for some) master's programmes in Korea
notes: Applicants who joined a KOICA fellowship in the past 3 years are generally not selected

name: KAUST Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)
who: STEM undergraduates (3rd year+) and master's students, GPA ≥3.5/4; not PhD students
benefits: US$1,000 a month, housing and airfare; 2–6 months
notes: One application at a time; no fee

name: OIST Research Internship
who: Undergraduate and master's students or recent graduates interested in a PhD
benefits: ¥2,400 per working day, campus housing, flights, insurance; 4–6 months
notes: Most recent deadline 15 Oct 2026; check the official page for the next round

name: CERN Summer Student Programme 2027
who: Bachelor's or master's students (not PhD) in physics, engineering, computer science or maths with 6+ semesters; non-member-state nationals eligible
benefits: CHF 94 a day + health insurance; 8–13 weeks
notes: Vacancy SUMM-2027 published; check careers.cern for the deadline
